svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Daily drivers: C#, .NET, React, TypeScript, Azure, MySQL, Redis, Docker, Actions, CF Workers. Azure platform: Container Apps, Service Bus, Functions, Key Vault, Entra ID, App Insights, Blob Storage. Architecture: Event-driven, Dead-letter replay, Circuit breakers, Idempotency, Blue-green, Hub-and-spoke. Quality & security: xUnit, Playwright, Vitest, EF Core, RBAC, Managed identity, Audit logging. Also shipped with: Java, Spring, Python, CPP, Angular, ExpressJS, MongoDB, Kubernetes, AWS, Linux.

g.text: Daily drivers, and the platform and practices around them
